description: Sijang shopping: a full traditional-market trip for wheelchair and seated shoppers. Six stalls and twelve items on one basket checklist that cannot check out while anything is missing, plus a big-text help-phrase card for high stalls - four polite Korean phrases, spoken aloud by TTS or shown large, with the request recorded on a steady-head nod. Merged boutique rebuild of CC09 high-shelf-ask and KR14 sijang-basket.
name: sijang-shopping
